title: Donald Trump wins the US presidential election and Zelensky congratulates him
body:
On 6 November 2024 the Kyiv Independent reported that Republican Donald Trump was on the brink of winning the US presidential election, needing only a few more electoral votes to reach 270, with Democratic candidate Kamala Harris's chances looking increasingly slim. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky congratulated Trump on X, calling it an impressive election victory.

Zelensky said he hoped for strong bipartisan US support for Ukraine and recalled a meeting with Trump in September 2024, at which they discussed the Ukraine-US strategic partnership, Ukraine's Victory Plan and ways to end Russia's aggression. He praised Trump's peace through strength approach, which he said could help bring a just peace in Ukraine closer, and said he looked forward to congratulating Trump in person.

The Kyiv Independent noted that Trump's return created uncertainty about US support for Ukraine, with some fearing a deal with the Kremlin that would pressure Kyiv into concessions. Under President Joe Biden, Washington had been Ukraine's leading military supporter. In September 2024 Trump had praised his relationships with both Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin, and a few weeks later he blamed Zelensky and Biden for Russia's invasion without mentioning Putin.
